scoring_justification: Full recomputation of the GEANT4 Monte Carlo simulation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; scoring relies on domain-invariant structural relations and self-consistency checks that the paper’s findings imply.

outputs.description: Energy deposition altitude profiles for power-law SEP spectra (gamma=0..3) for protons and electrons.
Ion pair production rate profile for the October 22, 1989 SEP event, split by particle type.
Ion pair production rate profile for the June 14, 1989 SEP event, split by particle type.

output_contract.notes: The ion_production_oct1989.csv is the mandatory load-bearing scored artifact; the other scored artifacts are supporting but also carry weight. All CSV files are expected to contain exactly 30 rows corresponding to the atmospheric layers.

steps.description: Structural checks: proton centroid altitude increases with gamma (0->1->2->3), electron centroid altitude increases with gamma, and for each gamma the electron centroid lies below the proton centroid.
Self-consistency (total = proton + electron) plus electron peak altitude in 50-70 km, electron/total ratio <0.1 below 10 km and max ratio in 50-70 km between 0.2 and 0.5.
Self-consistency, electron rate exceeds proton rate at 70 km, and electron peak altitude in 50-70 km.
